description: Send a question to the seller of a Boatsite advert on the buyer's behalf. It is saved to the buyer's Boatsite inbox, where the seller's reply arrives, and the seller is notified. At most 2 per buyer per advert a day. It cannot be unsent: show the user the exact message and send it only once they agree. Needs the user to connect their Boatsite account.

message.description: The buyer's question to the seller.

name: make_enquiry
title: Message a seller
